As Liberty Global Plc (LBTYK) Market Valuation Declined, Stockbridge Partners Boosted Its Holding by $80.53 Million; At&T (T) Shareholder Savant Capital Raised Its Holding by $371,450 as Stock Price Declined
May 17, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Savant Capital Llc increased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 16.6% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Savant Capital Llc bought 9,775 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 68,648 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.67 million, up from 58,873 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Savant Capital Llc who had been investing in At&T Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $196.21B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.08% or $0.35 during the last trading session, reaching $31.95. About 19.40 million shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 15.88% since May 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500.
Sharlyn C. Heslam increased its stake in Liberty Global Plc (LBTYK) by 143.11% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stockbridge Partners Llc bought 2.44M shares as the company’s stock declined 7.44% with the market. The hedge fund run by Sharlyn C. Heslam held 4.15 million shares of the television services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $140.29M, up from 1.71 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stockbridge Partners Llc who had been investing in Liberty Global Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $22.81 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.39% or $0.4 during the last trading session, reaching $28.37. About 3.14M shares traded. Liberty Global plc (NASDAQ:LBTYK) has declined 10.09% since May 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.64% the S&P500.
Stockbridge Partners Llc, which manages about $1.82 billion and $2.13B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Liberty Media Corp Delaware by 97,969 shares to 2.24 million shares, valued at $76.55 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Amazon Com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN) by 6,402 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 121,599 shares, and cut its stake in Liberty Global Plc (NASDAQ:LBTYA).
